messages:
kate-partner-ops: Quick sync — ACME HW asked how to submit compliance artifacts for marketplace listing (SOC2, pen test, questionnaires). They want details on encryption, redaction scope, TTL, and sign-off owner. Can we confirm ingest policy and owners?

alex_garcia: I can own the ingestion mapping but need the exact allowed formats and whether we require presigned uploads vs us pulling. Also who does redaction?

priya: Security requirements summary: 1) Allowed files: PDF, ZIP (max 500MB), CSV manifest. 2) Each file must have SHA256 hash in manifest. 3) All uploads encrypted at rest; partners should upload to presigned S3 URLs we provide. 4) We require SOC2 Type II PDF and a 3rd-party pen-test report (redacted sensitive findings), plus a remediation summary from the vendor. 5) Partners must attest that PII/CIP/keys are redacted before upload — we will spot-check and request follow-ups.

mike_partner_engineer: +1 on presigned. I can add an upload helper script for partners. Example we plan to give them:
```bash
# generate upload
aws s3 cp REPORT.zip "$PRESIGNED_URL" --acl private
```
We also need a consistent manifest schema — I'll draft one.

liam_reid: Marketplace note — manifest must include: listing_id, partner_id, region, file_type, sha256, upload_ts. That lets us attach artifacts to the right listing.

priya: Redaction rules (high level): remove full account IDs, API keys, syslog PII (usernames okay with truncation), and any screenshots containing secrets. If partner can't redact, they must request a secure redaction session and explain why.

kate-partner-ops: Legal asked if they need a signed attestation. answer: yes, an attestation letter on partner letterhead with date + signatory name. We should provide a template.

tom-oncall: Operational constraints — presigned URLs should be short-lived (48h). After upload we'll run an automated ingest job that will: validate manifest hashes, virus-scan, store into encrypted bucket with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/redwood-marketplace-artifacts, then tag and TTL policy. Archive policy: active bucket 30 days, then move to cold archive for 365 days. Do we want that?

priya: Security ask: 30 days active + 365 archive is fine for listing docs. For pen-test raw output we should archive 180 days encrypted, access-by-request only.

mike_partner_engineer: Draft manifest snippet: 
```json
{
  "listing_id": "rwd-1234",
  "partner_id": "acme-hw",
  "files": [
    {"name":"soc2-type2.pdf","type":"soc2","sha256":"<hash>"},
    {"name":"pentest-summary.pdf","type":"pentest","sha256":"<hash>"}
  ]
}
```
I'll attach a proper schema in drive.

alex_garcia: I'll map the manifest fields to our upload pipeline and add validation rules. ETA: EOD Tuesday for a PoC presign endpoint + sample manifest validator.

liam_reid: For marketplace UI we need a metadata flag: compliance_artifact_status (pending/approved/requires_action) so product can show partner status. Can we emit that after ingest?

alex_garcia: Yes — ingest job will emit a webhook to the marketplace service with status. I'll include that in the PoC.

kate-partner-ops: Action items: 1) Mike — upload script + manifest schema (today). 2) Alex — presign endpoint + validator PoC (EOD Tue). 3) Priya/Tom — finalize retention and KMS policy (Thu). 4) Liam — UI flag mapping (Thu). 5) Kate — attestation template + partner message (today).

priya: one more: If partner provides full pen-test raw logs (not preferred) we require an NDA+controlled access and will need a legal timestamped request. Mention this to ACME.

kate-partner-ops: Will do. I'll send the partner the short checklist + attestation template and link to Mike's upload helper when ready.

sec_bot: Checklist generated: soc2_type2.pdf, pentest_summary.pdf, remediation_statement.txt, signed_attestation.pdf, manifest.json. Presign TTL 48h. Archive policy: docs 365 days, pentest_raw 180 days.

mike_partner_engineer: tagging the drive doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (draft manifest + upload example).

alex_garcia: thumbs up. I'll ping infra for KMS key policy after tom/priya finalize.

kate-partner-ops: Thanks all — I'll update ACME after we have the PoC. :+1:

liam_reid: Thanks — this should get the listing unstuck.

kate-partner-ops: Closing thread after deliverables done.
